name: Bun v1.4.2
body:
To install Bun v1.4.2
```bash
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
# or you can use npm
# npm install -g bun
```

Windows:
```bash
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1|iex"
```

To upgrade to Bun v1.4.2:
```bash
bun upgrade
```

### [Read Bun v1.4.2's release notes on Bun's blog](https://bun.sh/blog/bun-v1.4.2)
